misc: Primary organizer of the Hector Trophée event.
biography: Toni stands as the foundational figure of the Hector Trophée, not merely as a competitor, but as the primary organizer whose vision brought this esteemed pair competition to fruition. His unwavering dedication to the event's success has been palpable since its inception, fostering its growth into a prominent fixture on the golfing calendar. Beyond the meticulous organizational efforts, Toni consistently demonstrates a profound commitment to the spirit of competition.

A testament to his enduring passion for the sport, Toni holds the distinction of having participated in every single edition of the Hector Trophée since its inaugural event in 2014, marking a remarkable twelve consecutive appearances. This impressive streak is complemented by a stellar competitive record; Toni has hoisted the coveted Hector Trophée on three separate occasions, showcasing his prowess in the demanding pair format. Furthermore, his individual brilliance has been recognized with two Victor Trophy titles, cementing his status as one of the tournament's most decorated players, a feat made all the more extraordinary given his concurrent responsibilities behind the scenes.

As the Hector Trophée prepares for its 2026 edition, Toni is poised to extend his unparalleled record to a thirteenth consecutive appearance. His unique position as both the event's architect and one of its most celebrated champions makes his continued presence a highlight, embodying the very essence of competitive golf intertwined with a dedication to the sport's community.
